items.title: Cassandra: Undefined column name tenant_id in table catalog.products
items.body:
I am using Cassandra 4.0.x with spring boot, I create my table with two primary key, one clustering and one partition. However, whenever I try to query some data I get an error saying that the column is not defined

Undefined column name tenant_id in table catalog.products; nested exception is com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.servererrors.InvalidQueryException: Undefined column name tenant_id in table catalog.products

Here is my table definition and the executed query:

cqlsh:catalog> DESCRIBE products ;

CREATE TABLE catalog.products (
    "TENANT_ID" text,
    "CODE" text,
    "CREATION_TS" timestamp,
    "EAN" text,
    "MANCODE" text,
    "MAXOQTE" int,
    "MINOQTE" int,
    "MODIFIED_TS" timestamp,
    "OFFLINEDATE" date,
    "ONLINEDATE" date,
    "P_TENANT_ID" text,
    "REFCODE" text,
    "SVHC" text,
    "TYPNAME" text,
    "TYPNAMESEO" text,
    "LOCDESCRIP" map<text, text>,
    "LOCNAME" map<text, text>,
    "LOCNAMESEO" map<text, text>,
    "PARENTS" set<text>,
    "SHORTDESC" map<text, text>,
    PRIMARY KEY ("TENANT_ID", "CODE")
) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY ("CODE" ASC)
    AND additional_write_policy = '99p'
    AND bloom_filter_fp_chance = 0.01
    AND caching = {'keys': 'ALL', 'rows_per_partition': 'NONE'}
    AND cdc = false
    AND comment = ''
    AND compaction = {'class': 'org.apache.cassandra.db.compaction.SizeTieredCompactionStrategy', 'max_threshold': '32', 'min_threshold': '4'}
    AND compression = {'chunk_length_in_kb': '16', 'class': 'org.apache.cassandra.io.compress.LZ4Compressor'}
    AND crc_check_chance = 1.0
    AND default_time_to_live = 0
    AND extensions = {}
    AND gc_grace_seconds = 864000
    AND max_index_interval = 2048
    AND memtable_flush_period_in_ms = 0
    AND min_index_interval = 128
    AND read_repair = 'BLOCKING'
    AND speculative_retry = '99p';

CREATE INDEX pp_tenant_id_idx ON catalog.products ("P_TENANT_ID");

CREATE INDEX pr_ean_idx ON catalog.products ("EAN");

CREATE INDEX pr_mancode_idx ON catalog.products ("MANCODE");

CREATE INDEX pr_offlinedate_idx ON catalog.products ("OFFLINEDATE");

CREATE INDEX pr_onlinedate_idx ON catalog.products ("ONLINEDATE");

CREATE INDEX pr_refcode_idx ON catalog.products ("REFCODE");

CREATE INDEX pr_typname_idx ON catalog.products ("TYPNAME");

CREATE INDEX pr_typnameseo_idx ON catalog.products ("TYPNAMESEO");
cqlsh:catalog>

Executed (generated) query:

SELECT * FROM products WHERE TENANT_ID='19001' AND code='11015383' AND onlinedate <= toDate(now()) AND offlinedate >= toDate(now()) ALLOW FILTERING;

Exception:

org.springframework.data.cassandra.CassandraInvalidQueryException: Query; CQL [SELECT * FROM products WHERE  TENANT_ID=?  AND onlinedate <= toDate(now()) AND offlinedate >= toDate(now()) AND code=?  ALLOW FILTERING]; Undefined column name tenant_id in table catalog.products; nested exception is com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.servererrors.InvalidQueryException: Undefined column name tenant_id in table catalog.products
    at org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.cql.CassandraExceptionTranslator.translate(CassandraExceptionTranslator.java:125) ~[spring-data-cassandra-3.4.3.jar!/:3.4.3]
    at org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.cql.CassandraAccessor.translate(CassandraAccessor.java:422) ~[spring-data-cassandra-3.4.3.jar!/:3.4.3]
    at org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.cql.CqlTemplate.translateException(CqlTemplate.java:764) ~[spring-data-cassandra-3.4.3.jar!/:3.4.3]
    at org.springframework.data.cassandra.core.cql.CqlTemplate.query(CqlTemplate.java:545) ~[spring-data-cassandra-3.4.3.jar!/:3.4.3]

I thought it might be a compact storage issue but it is not the case:

cqlsh:catalog> alter table products drop compact storage;
InvalidRequest: Error from server: code=2200 [Invalid query] message="Cannot DROP COMPACT STORAGE on table without COMPACT STORAGE"
cqlsh:catalog>
